changeSet.author: hms
changeSet.comment: Add the Phase 3 HR role to the authority table

changeSet.author: hms
changeSet.comment: Seed one development login for the HR role (password: admin)
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO jhi_user ( id, login, password_hash, first_name, last_name, email, activated, lang_key, created_by, created_date, last_modified_by, last_modified_date ) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), v.login, h.password_hash, v.first_name, v.last_name, v.email, true, 'en', 'system', now(), 'system', now() FROM (VALUES ('hr', 'Human', 'Resources', 'hr@localhost') ) AS v(login, first_name, last_name, email) CROSS JOIN (VALUES -- The BCrypt hash of 'admin', the same one every development account carries. Dev only. ('$2a$10$gSAhZrxMllrbgj/kkK9UceBPpChGWJA7SYIb1Mqo.n5aNLq1/oRrC') ) AS h(password_hash) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jhi_user existing WHERE existing.login = v.login);
INSERT INTO jhi_user_authority (user_id, authority_name) SELECT u.id, v.authority_name FROM (VALUES ('hr', 'ROLE_HR'), ('hr', 'ROLE_USER') ) AS v(login, authority_name) INNER JOIN jhi_user u ON u.login = v.login ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
